Amazon PPC
PPC Management

PPC Management

Amazon PPC

Campaign setup, restructuring and ongoing optimization across Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands and Sponsored Display, with the focus on cutting wasted spend, improving ACOS and scaling the keywords and products that actually convert.

What’s covered

  • Account and campaign audit to find wasted spend, poor structure and missed opportunities
  • Campaign structure built around match types, product groups and campaign goals
  • Keyword research, harvesting from search term reports and negative keyword management
  • Product, category and competitor ASIN targeting
  • Bid, budget and placement optimization (top of search, product pages, rest of search)
  • Sponsored Brands and Display campaigns for brand awareness and retargeting
  • Launch campaigns for new products and ranking support for existing ones

How I measure success

  • ACOS, TACOS and ROAS tracked against your profit margins
  • Spend, sales, impressions, CTR, CPC and conversion rate trends
  • Wasted spend reduced, and sales scaled where profitable
  • Clear reporting, so you always know where the budget goes and what it returns
Fulfillment
FBA Operations

FBA Operations

Fulfillment

Day-to-day FBA support so stock keeps moving, shipments don’t get stuck and you avoid stock-outs that hurt rankings and sales.

What’s covered

  • FBA shipment creation, packing details and carrier set-up in Send to Amazon
  • Choosing the right inbound placement and destination fulfillment centers
  • Tracking shipments from created to closed and resolving receiving discrepancies
  • Inventory planning and replenishment based on sales velocity and lead time
  • Stranded and unfulfillable inventory resolution
  • Removal orders, reimbursement claims for lost or damaged units, and Prime eligibility checks

Why it matters

Late or mis-planned inventory means lost Buy Box time and lost ranking. A tidy shipment workflow keeps units received quickly, keeps listings in stock and keeps storage and long-term fees under control.

The shipment queue above shows multiple FBA shipments sent to different fulfillment centers, all closed with every unit received and Prime eligible.

Organic Growth
Listing SEO

Listing SEO

Organic Growth

Keyword-driven listing optimization to improve visibility in Amazon search and turn more of that traffic into orders. Every element of the page is written for both the A10 algorithm and the real shopper.

My process

  • Keyword and competitor research to find high-intent, high-volume search terms
  • SEO-optimized titles that lead with the most important keywords and stay readable
  • Benefit-driven bullet points that answer buyer questions and handle objections
  • Product descriptions and A+ Content direction that support conversion
  • Backend search terms that capture keywords the front end can’t fit
  • Image and infographic guidance so the main image and gallery sell the product

What to look for in the example

  • A clear, keyword-rich title covering the product type, age range and key use
  • Descriptive subtitle and bullets that cover materials, safety, use cases and gift occasions
  • A complete variation set, with color and bundle options on one listing
  • Strong social proof: a 4.8 star rating, over 10,000 ratings and the Amazon’s Choice badge
Account Health
Seller Central

Seller Central

Account Health

Seller Central troubleshooting and account health management, focused on keeping accounts compliant, metrics inside Amazon’s targets and listings live. A healthy account protects every other part of the business: ads, inventory and the Buy Box all depend on it.

What I monitor

  • Account Health Rating and the Healthy / At Risk status
  • Order Defect Rate across negative feedback, A-to-z Guarantee claims and chargebacks
  • Late Shipment Rate, Pre-fulfillment Cancel Rate and Valid Tracking Rate
  • On-Time Delivery Rate and Business Hour Delivery Rate
  • Policy issues: intellectual property, product authenticity, product condition, restricted products, listing and review policy

How I help

  • Weekly account health audits with a clear list of risks and fixes
  • Plan of Action and appeal writing for suspensions, listing removals and policy warnings
  • Case management with Seller Support until the issue is actually resolved
  • Root-cause fixes, so the same violation does not return
  • Performance tracking against Amazon’s targets, with alerts before a metric slips

The dashboard above shows a clean, healthy account: a Healthy status with a rating of 248, a 0% Order Defect Rate for both seller-fulfilled and FBA orders, zero open policy issues, a 0% Late Shipment Rate and a 100% Valid Tracking Rate.

Catalog
Flat File & Variations

Flat File & Variations

Catalog

Bulk catalog work with flat files, including parent-child variation setup, bulk updates and fixes for broken listings. Done right, it saves hours of manual editing and keeps your catalog clean, consistent and easy for customers to browse.

What’s covered

  • Parent-child variation setup for size, color, style, pack size and more
  • Repairing broken, split or merged variation families
  • Bulk listing creation and bulk updates (titles, bullets, prices, quantities, images) through flat file uploads
  • Attribute, product type and browse node corrections
  • Fixing upload errors and processing report issues
  • Catalog cleanup, such as duplicate listings, wrong categories and missing attributes

Why it matters

Correct variations put all your options on one listing, which pools reviews and sales history and makes shopping easier. Clean catalog data also means fewer suppressed listings and better search visibility.
